name: GetSegmentDesc
response_attachment: cached SegmentDesc JSON or empty if no snapshot

name: BootstrapRdma
request_attachment: BootstrapDesc JSON with ordered local and peer NIC paths, data QPN vector, LID, GID, notify QPN and reply_msg
response_attachment: BootstrapDesc; nonempty reply_msg fails, empty local_gid fails

name: SendData
request_attachment: little-endian uint64 peer address and length followed by exactly the caller's bytes
response_attachment: empty success, error text on range, permission or copy failure

name: RecvData
request_attachment: little-endian uint64 peer address and length
response_attachment: payload of exactly the requested length; service error text must differ in length from requested data

name: Notify
request_attachment: JSON object with name and msg strings
response_attachment: empty only on delivery; malformed notification prefix differs from callback rejection

name: Delegate
request_attachment: JSON opcode READ or WRITE, source pointer as integer, target_id, target_offset, length; local policy fields omitted
response_attachment: empty success, Status text on failure

name: Pin
response_attachment: JSON unsigned address, zero on exhaustion

name: NotifySegmentUpdated
response_attachment: empty; invalidate all cached descriptors for that name

name: BootstrapUb
request_attachment: UbBootstrapDesc JSON with separate Jetty, EID and generation fields
response_attachment: UB envelope; recognize reserved ID, native transport excluded
